 Kathmandu Gorkhas vs Chitwan Rhinos Preview & Prediction | 2026 Nepal Premier League | Eliminator
 by Alex Sarwar · 17 November 2026 at 1:00 pm 
 Updated 17 November 2026 at 4:09 pm 
 Post 
 Share 
 Click here for today’s sports betting tips from our expert analysts! 
 It’s win or go home for both Kathmandu Gorkhas and Chitwan Rhinos in this high-stakes contest. 
 Date & time: 
 18 November 2026 at 10:45 am 
 Venue:  Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur, Nepal
 Weather:  Little sign of rain, with temperatures peaking at around 18c before dropping rapidly.
 How to watch:  UK – NETTV App / USA – NETTV App / Nepal – Himalaya Sports Network and NETTV App
 Kathmandu Gorkhas vs Chitwan Rhinos prediction 
 Kathmandu Gorkhas may have finished above Chitwan Rhinos in the league stage, but they head into the eliminator in poor form, which is hardly a good sign with their tournament now on the line. The Gorkhas have lost back-to-back games, and the latter was a heavy one, as already-eliminated Pokhara Avengers thrashed them by 55 runs.
 Chitwan Rhinos were also beaten last time out, going down by 24 runs to Karnali Yaks. When these two teams last clashed earlier this month, it was Kathmandu who came out on top by ten runs.
 Kathmandu had already secured their playoff place before that defeat to Pokhara, so motivation was likely low. Now that the league stage is over and knockout cricket begins, you would expect them to lock in. Chitwan, meanwhile, have struggled with inconsistency throughout the tournament.
 Back a fired-up Gorkhas side to react well and do enough to keep their campaign alive.
 Kathmandu Gorkhas vs Chitwan Rhinos tip:  Kathmandu Gorkhas to win
